question.knowledge_point: Identifying a Matrix by Its Description
question.problem:
Which of the following is a $3\times 1$ matrix?

$$
F=[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 & 3 \\ 3 & 1 & 5 \\ 3 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,G=[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{3} \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,H=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
- The matrix $F$ has $3$ rows and $3$ columns. So, its dimensions are $3\times 3.$ $\,\times $

- The matrix $G$ has $3$ rows and $1$ column. So, its dimensions are $3\times 1.$ $\,✓$

- The matrix $H$ has $1$ row and $3$ columns. So, its dimensions are $1\times 3.$ $\,\times $

Therefore, only $G$ is a $3\times 1$ matrix.
